name: Bush bean

schedule.notes: Inoculate seed with rhizobia for best yields on new beds.
Succession plant every 2 weeks for fresh beans all summer.
Pick at pencil thickness; every 2 to 3 days keeps plants producing.

harvest.cues: Pods are firm and snap cleanly. Don't wait for bumps — those are over-mature.
harvest.storageNotes: Fridge 5 to 7 days. Blanch and freeze for longer storage.

varieties.name: Dragon Tongue
varieties.notes: Yellow with purple streaks (fades in cooking). Stunning.

notes: Don't water until seedlings emerge — wet seed rots. Don't handle beans when wet to avoid spreading disease.
